text:
Ana Morales: Quick kickoff 1 1 design request for the benchmark launch (webinar + email + socials). Need a small but flexible asset set: 1) one-page benchmark explainer (web + PDF), 2) animated GIF that visualizes latency vs cost across deployment modes, 3) two email header variants (1:3 and 1:1 crop), 4) slide master with routed CTA and a fixed code-snippet area, 5) icon + SVG set and an accessibility-friendly mono fallback. Brand + a11y required. First drafts: Fri EOD.
Luis Ortega: copy question 

metrics to show? p95 and p50 latency, tokens/sec, and cost normalized per 1k tokens? I suggest cost/1k so it's digestible in email.
Priya Kapoor: Messaging notes: propose two headline variants: marketing-friendly "Serve smarter: predictable latency, efficient cost" and conservative "Predictable latency with competitive unit economics" for APAC/legal. We'll need both layered.
Lina Chen: Design clarifications: GIF duration? Should it loop quietly (3s) or be a micro-animation with a reduced-motion fallback? Also what's the max filesize for email headers?
Kate Rivera: Brand constraints: use Approved Blue #0A6CF0 for primary CTA accents, Neutral Text Dark #0B0B0B for copy, logo clearspace per Brand Kit v2. Provide SVG logos + flattened PNGs. All text must meet AA contrast; aim for AAA for small caption text. GIFs need a reduced-motion variant (single frame). Also provide a colorblind-friendly palette and a mono patterned fallback for print.
Design-Bot: Starter Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/bench-q3-mini-pack. Export defaults embedded:
```
- one-pager: 1200x900 PNG + PDF, sRGB, max 2MB
- hero GIF: 800x450 GIF, 3s loop, max 150KB for web, provide MP4 fallback for social
- email header (wide): 1200x400 PNG @2x, max 200KB
- email header (square): 800x800 PNG @2x, max 150KB
- slide master: 1920x1080 PNG + PPTX master export, left gutter 96px, reserve 320x160px code box
- icons: SVG + 24px/32px PNG exports
- alt_text: frame with one-line alt strings for each asset
```
Luis Ortega: sample labeling numbers for the visuals (use Hosted as baseline): Hosted: p95=290ms, p50=90ms, tokens/sec=170, cost/1k=$0.90. Dedicated: p95=160ms, p50=50ms, tokens/sec=480, cost/1k=$0.55. Private: p95=200ms, p50=70ms, tokens/sec=410, cost/1k=$0.48. Use Hosted as the baseline bar and show percent delta in the GIF.
Jordan Lee: Routing: CTA on slide/button should map to webinar form and tag leads with "bench_launch_q3_2026". Add utm_campaign=bench_q3 and utm_source when posting to social. I'll need a CSV mapping: CTA text, destination, lead tag, utm params. I can own wiring once assets are uploaded.
Priya Kapoor: Legal reminder: no absolutes (e.g., "lowest cost"). Keep any cost-delta phrasing illustrative (use ranges) and include a metadata strip: "Model: open-llm-7B 2 seq len 512 2 test harness: see notes" (test harness link should be behind a disclosure on site; slide may show "see notes"). Also provide a conservative-language layer in Figma for APAC.
Kate Rivera: Accessibility addendum: GIFs must include captions or have an ARIA-friendly alt; provide reduced-motion single-frame exports. Ensure icon stroke weights match the icon spec and provide high-contrast SVGs for screen readers.
Lina Chen: I'll include a micro-sparkline to show caching/batching effect in the one-pager and a small infographic tile "cache + batching -> illustrative 30-45% lower cost" (annotative). We'll include an SVG icon set and a motion_opt layer for Lottie-friendly export. Posting first frames Wed EOB.
Design-Bot: stub assets uploaded to /s3/marketing/bench/q3/5223344556_stubs.zip (permissions: marketing-team). Please check.
CRM-Bot: Campaign slot reserved: 2026-07-21 09:00 UTC for benchmark email send (auto-note).
Ana Morales: QA ownership: Marketing owns copy QA; Design owns visual QC (contrast/export checks); Jordan owns routing verification. Timeline recap: first frames Wed EOB, draft exports Fri EOD, final handoff next Wed. If any blocker, flag here.
Luis Ortega: small ask for the slide: reserve 320x160px fixed-width box for a monospace code snippet (sample query latency). Lina 1 please add dark-mode variant.
Priya Kapoor: I'll upload conservative copy strings and request translations (JP/KO/FR/DE) once we have final copy on Fri. Need translations by Mon EOB next week.
Lina Chen: First Figma frames posted: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/frame-q3-A 1 contains one-pager draft, GIF storyboard, email headers, slide master with reserved code box. Feedback welcome; I'll iterate tomorrow.
Jordan Lee: Left routing checklist comment 1 include CSV template with columns: asset_name, cta_text, dest_url, lead_tag, utm_campaign, utm_source. I'll watch for the final zip.
Ana Morales: Thanks team 1 please drop screenshots here for quick review. Tag Jordan & Priya when final assets are uploaded. :art::sparkles:
Kate Rivera: Visual pass tonight 1 will check color swaps and logo lockups. Please don't lock gradients over the logo.
Design-Bot: Checklist status: [x] Figma file, [x] stub upload, [ ] alt_text CSV, [ ] final exports, [ ] routing CSV. Link to PRD: https://internal.redwood/ops/bench-q3-prd
Ana Morales: Closing 1 see you on Wed for frames. If anything changes on timing, update this thread.
